title: metrics rsp
description: Response to cmd:metrics. Describes what MetricsRegistry::snapshot_json (backend/include/xi/xi_metrics.hpp) ACTUALLY emits into data: top-level frames_total/frames_ok/frames_error counters plus an inspect_compute_ms block (count/sum_ms/mean_ms and a `buckets` ARRAY of {bucket_ms,count}). The array has one entry per fixed edge (0.5,1,2,5,10,20,50,100,200,500,1000,2000,5000) followed by a final overflow entry whose `bucket_ms` is the STRING "inf" — hence `bucket_ms` is number-or-string. `bucket_ms` is the bucket's NON-cumulative upper bound: `count` is frames in [prev_bound, bucket_ms), NOT frames <= bucket_ms. (The key was `le` — the Prometheus name for a CUMULATIVE ≤ edge — but these counts are per-bucket occupancy, so it was renamed to bucket_ms to stop consumers misreading it as cumulative. An earlier fixture modelled buckets as a fixed-key object le_1..gt_50 and omitted the frame counters; that never matched the backend and is corrected here.)
